summary: Plan review shows the plan an agent proposes before it starts work, as a numbered list a person can change. They can rewrite a step, skip one, add their own, and then approve so the agent runs through the steps in the same view.
use: When a task is large enough that people should agree on the steps before the agent touches anything.
When a person wants to drop a step or rewrite it in their own words without starting over.
When you want the approved plan to double as a progress list while the agent runs.
When the person needs a Stop button once the agent is under way.
features: Three phases: `review` lets people edit steps, `running` shows progress and a Stop button, and `done` shows See changes.
In review, clicking a step makes its text editable. Enter saves it, and the step is marked as edited only if the words really changed.
Each step has a skip button. Skipped steps stay in the list, struck through, and lose their number until they are included again.
Add a step appends a new row and puts the cursor in it with the text selected.
Steps can show `state: 'run'` while the agent works on them, with a spinner and a shimmer on the text, `'retry'` in amber while it waits out a problem like a rate limit, and a check once `done`.
Each step can report a `detail` line under it, like "6 frames and 42 tokens read". It opens under the step and crossfades when it changes.

The status line defaults to how many steps are left in and about how many minutes they take. `status` and `note` replace the defaults. `meta` adds quiet text at the end of the header, like an elapsed time.
a11y: In review, each step's text has `role="textbox"` and an `aria-label` like "Step 2".
The skip button's `aria-label` switches between "Skip step" and "Include step".
Pressing Enter in a step ends the edit instead of adding a new line.

faq.q: How do I start the agent once the plan is approved?
faq.a: Handle `onApprove`, set `phase` to `running`, and mark steps with `state: 'run'` and `'done'` as your agent works. Set `phase` to `done` at the end.

faq.q: How do I get the edited plan back?
faq.a: Pass `steps` and `onStepsChange` to control the list. Each step comes back with its new `text`, plus `edited` and `skipped` flags you can send to the agent.

faq.q: Can I stop the agent halfway?
faq.a: In the `running` phase the footer shows a Stop button that calls `onStop`. Stopping the agent and updating the phase is up to your code.

faq.q: Can it sit on its own instead of inside a chat?
faq.a: Yes. It is flat by default to sit in a chat thread. Set `bare={false}` to give it its own card.
